name: @mc-manager/daemon-desktop
//productName: Also sets app.getName(), which decides the userData folder. Without it Electron uses `name` and the node's config lands in AppData/Roaming/@mc-manager/daemon-desktop.
description: Desktop node agent for MC Hosting
author: MC Hosting

scripts.build:ts: node scripts/bundle-main.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run stage
scripts.//release: Builds and uploads to GitHub Releases. Needs GH_TOKEN set and the version in this file bumped first.

//devDependencies: electron-updater is a devDependency because scripts/bundle-main.mjs inlines it into dist/. Listing it under dependencies would make electron-builder look for it in this workspace's node_modules, where npm's hoisting means it does not exist.
